generic_name: Insulin (Human or Analog) via Bolus Pump Delivery, 200 Units
drug_class: Rapid-Acting or Short-Acting Insulin / Antidiabetic Agent
purpose: This is insulin delivered through an insulin pump to help control your blood sugar around mealtimes or to correct a high blood sugar reading. It works quickly to bring your glucose levels back into a healthy range. People with type 1 or type 2 diabetes often use this method for more precise blood sugar management.
how_it_works: Think of insulin as a key that unlocks your body's cells so sugar from your food can get inside and be used for energy. When you eat a meal or notice your blood sugar is too high, the pump delivers a set dose of insulin directly under your skin in seconds. This fast-acting insulin gets to work quickly, usually within 15 minutes, and helps your blood sugar come down to a normal level.
common_side_effects: The most common side effect is low blood sugar (hypoglycemia), which can make you feel shaky, sweaty, dizzy, confused, or very hungry. You may also notice mild redness, swelling, or irritation at the site where the pump tubing is inserted. Weight gain can sometimes occur with regular insulin use.
warnings: Low blood sugar is the most important risk — always have a fast-acting sugar source nearby, like glucose tablets or juice. Never skip meals after giving a bolus dose. Check your pump site regularly to avoid infections or blockages. Talk to your doctor right away if you have repeated unexplained high or low blood sugar readings. Alcohol, certain medicines, and illness can all affect how insulin works in your body.
typical_dosing: The 200-unit dose refers to the amount of insulin loaded into the pump reservoir, not one single injection dose. Your actual bolus dose is customized just for you by your diabetes care team based on your carbohydrate intake, current blood sugar, and insulin-to-carb ratio. Most people take a bolus dose before each meal and sometimes a small correction dose if blood sugar is running high. Your pump is programmed with your personal settings to help calculate the right amount each time.
